possibleMatches.name: RevenueFlow
possibleMatches.description: A professional revenue and agency management SaaS for consulting firms and agencies to track clients, contracts, invoices, team utilization, and revenue forecasting. Features a comprehensive 7-tab dashboard with MRR/ARR KPIs, revenue trend charts, client tier distribution, renewal risk alerts for contracts expiring within 60 days, team utilization gauges, full client CRUD with tier classification (Enterprise/Professional/Starter), contract management with multi-billing cycles, invoice tracking with paid/sent/overdue statuses, NRR (Net Revenue Retention) analysis, revenue forecasting projections, and 100% localStorage persistence. Pre-seeded with 6 clients, 6 contracts, 4 team members, 5 services, 6 months of revenue data, and 6 invoices. Works fully offline.

possibleMatches.name: FIRE Path Calculator
possibleMatches.description: An interactive FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early) calculator with wealth projection chart, milestone tracking, and scenario comparison to visualize your journey to financial freedom.

possibleMatches.name: Pinhole & Project
possibleMatches.description: Snip twelve runners and seat an aperture panel plus a two-tongue sliding paper screen in a camera bed. Customize real pinhole/window geometry, indexed projection distance and measured-reference sheet fits; local PNG/JPEG/SVG or verified ASCII/binary STL bed engravings, connected card, three clean STLs and ZIP. Tracing paper, opaque paper and tape required; gravity seated, physical printing and optics untested.

possibleMatches.name: Monge & Project
possibleMatches.description: Snip twenty runners and seat two perpendicular engraved screens plus two unequal-height eyelets on a plan plane, then compare a thread diagonal with three orthographic projections. Customize actual endpoint X/Y/Z spans and measured-reference sheet/socket fits; local PNG/JPEG/SVG or verified ASCII/binary STL apron engraving, connected-card, five clean STLs and ZIP. Thread and adhesive required; physical printing and fit untested.

possibleMatches.name: Duplex & Decode
possibleMatches.description: Snip twelve runners and stack two complementary perforated shares in an open-bottom registration cradle: a symbol emerges in their combined vertical projection. Customize real cell pitch, scramble seed, silhouettes and reference-derived sheet/carrier fits; local PNG/JPEG/SVG or verified ASCII/binary STL apron engravings, connected-card, three clean STLs and ZIP. No hardware or glue; physical printing and optical contrast untested.

possibleMatches.name: Polar & Project
possibleMatches.description: Snip eight runners and bond a pierced meridian ring into two reference-measured base sockets for a stereographic-projection kit. Customize real radius, ray angles, eyes and sheet fits; local PNG/JPEG/SVG or verified ASCII/binary STL base engravings, connected-card, clean-part STLs and ZIP. Thread, tape and adhesive required; front-face rays approximate, physical printing and assembly untested.

possibleMatches.name: Ray & Box
possibleMatches.description: Snip 24 runners and seat six opaque panels into sixteen calibrated tongue joints for a pinhole projection chamber with a paper-screen window. Measured sheet/carrier reference, adjustable aperture and chamber, local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL label grips; connected-card, per-part STL and assembly ZIP. Paper, opaque tape and adhesive required; optical performance untested.

assessment: No projector throw/letterboxing workflow found. Optical focus/panorama/flash utilities calculate unrelated camera-side capture plans; lighting utilities assess lumen/exposure, not projection zoom and native-aspect fit.
